projects.title: PubHub
projects.description:
• Created a Web Application for book publishing.
• Personal Project.
• Implemented MVC pattern with SOAP concepts, JDBC API, Servlets and JSP.
• Used AJAX & jQuery request data and make dynamic response processing. 
• PostgreSQL Database Architecture and Administration.
• Used JUnit Testing Framework to write and execute unit test cases for reliability.
• Version control with GitHub.
• Reviewed and accepted by mentor.
• Diligent work ethic and time management have been a result of completing phase 1/3 of this project.

projects.title: Authenticated Sign-in
projects.description:
Nowadays, almost every web-based system include an authentication module where users need sign in to access some features of the system. Attackers attempt to bypass the authentication to get unauthorized access. There are so many ways an attacker can succeed, and no matter how good our authentication is, we should be attempting to detect and react to unauthorized access. Yet, it would be careless not to include some basic design features of a password based authentication that makes it harder for the attacker and not more burdensome for the legitimate user. I will implement such an authentication module that should be able to be imported into future web-based systems.

• The Website will have three types of users: visitors, regular users and administrators. The regular users and administrators information will be stored in a MySQL database. 
• Access to a page will depend on which type of user attempts to load the page.
• Used salting and hashing to store the password in the table. 
• Implemented server/ client side form validation and verification with php and javascript
• Trying to access a page where access is denied should display an appropriate error message, for example, “you need to be logged in as an administrator to access this page” instead of displaying the regular contents of the page.
